info.description:
Chapter 1. Overview of Front Office Department

Chapter 2. FO Shift handling and Skills

Chapter 3. Telephone Handling

Chapter 4. Reservations

Chapter 5: Hotel registration

Chapter 6 : Handling guest inquiries and complaints

Chương 7: Departure and Cashiering

Chương 8: Hotel Safety & Security
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Students understand, remember and easily present the roles, tasks and skills needed for staff working in FO Department; FO operation and procedures; equipped with the basic knowledge to perform the work, handling guests’ complaints; Link this subject knowledge with other subjects of business administration specialized in hospitality industry.

Students can do FO procedures professionaly  (reservation, telephone handling, registarion, departure procedures ...); have communication experience, applying learned knowledge to do the job, as well as handling guests’ complaints.
Students are able to self-assess their competencies and thus improve their knowledge and skills to work well in FO Department.
Students are trained in professional ethics; High sense of responsibility in the work, always ready to do the best to get customer satisfaction, must consider themselves a professional receptionist.
